title: cacalia tricuspis
intro: Cacalia tricuspis, commonly known as "Three-pronged Cacalia" or "Cacalia trigona," is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is a perennial herb native to East Asia, traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is valued for its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Cacalia tricuspis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
